name: Translate to Filipino
description: The computer voice speaks what you say in Filipino (Tagalog). Needs live voice-to-speech. Downloads a 69 MB translation model once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Tagalog model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0.
